_meta.description: Hand-curated base-row -> Raphaela-hymn pairs for days where the corpus appoints DIFFERENT hymns from our base, so content matching cannot pair them. Read by scripts/menaion-ingest/raphaela-parish-build.js. Every pair must cite a packet the St John of Damascus choir sang (memory: feedback_tyler_match_connie). Keys are M-D; `index` is the hymn's position in that file's parsed section. A day whose packet shows the parish singing the BASE text instead carries "exclude": "<evidence>" and gets no Raphaela entries at all.

11-22._evidence: docs/choir-packets/2026-11-19/pdf/great-vespers-2026-11-21.pdf scan p.3: Lord I Call (6)(5)(4) Tone 1, to the special melody 'Joy of the Heavenly Hosts' — 'The virgins bearing lamps', 'The Theotokos, glorious fruit of a sacred promise', 'O Virgin, fed in faith' — the corpus's own November 22 set. Our base (stSergius, cid 2381) appoints the Tone 8 'O most glorious wonder' set there, which OCA/Lambertsen agree with.

lordICall.text:
As a branch of the Vine of Life, O glorious Philemon,
you distilled a wine of perfect divine knowledge to souls in distress,
and gladdened the hearts made sullen by the darkness of error
and enshrouded by the gloomy madness of idolatry.//
We joyfully celebrate the feast of your divinely-radiant memory.

Gaza honors you, O blessed Apostle,
having seen the light of perfect knowledge through you,
and the city of the Colossians, who have your divine body as a treasure,
harvests the healings and the grace that always pours forth abundantly.
Therefore, it keeps your commemoration,//
as it is preserved from dangers by your intercession,
O glorious Philemon.

In faith let us praise the wise hierarch Archippus,
together with the modest Apphia!
Let us sing hymns honoring the sacred heralds of God,
Philemon and Onesimus,
the venerable teachers who, by their teaching,
condemned the falsehood of polytheism
and planted the knowledge of Truth!//
Let us devoutly celebrate their memory!

11-22._evidenceAposticha: docs/choir-packets/2026-11-19/pdf/great-vespers-2026-11-21.pdf scan p.9: Apostikha Tone 2, to the special melody 'House of Ephratha' — 'The choir of virgins today have lit their torches', 'The prophet proclaimed you', 'O Zachariah, open the Temple gates' — the corpus's own November 22 Aposticha, in the base's order (stSergius 9436-9438: 'Having lit their candles…', 'O prophet, receive her…', 'Opening the portals of the sanctuary…'). Content scores too low to pair automatically.
11-22._evidenceApostles: Same packet, scan pp.3-4: Lord I Call (3)(2)(1) Tone 2 for the Apostles, to 'Joseph of Arimathea' — the same three hymns as stSergius 9432-9434 in another translation. Raphaela's November 22 file omits the Apostles, so the text is transcribed from the scan (2026-11-21).

9-6.exclude: docs/choir-packets/2026-09-04/pdf/great-vespers-2026-09-05.pdf — Lord I Call for the Miracle at Colossae is the OCA text in thee/thou ('O Michael, the Chief Captain, thou hast been revealed as the brightest attendant of the triply-radiant Godhead'), not Raphaela ('Michael, the supreme commander, you have been revealed as the bright messenger…'). Caught by packet-diff 2026-11-20 (9/9 -> 8/9 with the layer on).
